A32 011d2adc raw selector is image+f2fc, raw buffer is image+f310, and the five lengths are image+f324 through image+f334. NONMATCHING image_work fields in image_encoder_rest.c are shifted here.
A32 e51b9c initializes two words of each stack plane record. MPF destination consumers read only the first word; the remaining stack words are unobserved.
A32 011dbbe0 consumes five arguments; e51d5c passes seven, with the last two ignored.
A32 011dbe40 marks identity ready before loading configuration and publishing the identity block. Reentry with ready==1 leaves the published block unchanged.
A32 e51ee8 selection==2 copies the seven source words to output without clearing the request or calling lower processing; selection==1 emits kind3 and keeps enabled=0.
A32 e51ee8 stores request globally at154ce88, main plane154d860, subplane154d8ac and source plane154cc3c. The secondary plane pointer is original argument5; mode is original argument10.
A32 011d2778 uses image+f2f0 for compact padding, distinct from raw-output selector image+f2fc. The shared NONMATCHING image_work header merges these roles.

MPF header templates at011d4eb8 and011d4b10 contribute eight bytes each. First-pass uninitialized attributes.index selects a70- or82-byte attribute directory, but kind0 totals160/172 both align192 and kind1 totals86/98 both align128. Second-pass output overwrites all first-pass directory bytes and patches. The first-pass scratch contents are unobservable at return.
The four-byte MPF version source at011d4fa4 is ASCII0100, not the MPF marker inferred from its source name.
A32 011c8260 calls fill_u32(7221a0) with count8 to zero32 model-name bytes. NONMATCHING raf_write_header describes an eight-byte fill.
A32 011db6dc reads image work through raw+b608 and uses primary tags+148, secondary tags+574c, directories+ad50/+b1ac. The draft metadata_raf_job fields are shifted.
The fixed RAF rule table011c89c4 has ten twelve-byte records. Every order byte is1, so its width1/order2 reversal branch is source-backed unreachable with this immutable table.
A32 011dc010 starts its parameter cursor at011dc49c but reads kind/slot/quality at cursor-12/-8/-4. The first sixteen-byte parameter record is011dc490, not the inferred metadata_parameters symbol.
A32 011dbf48 sign-extends table geometry and compares full input words. It does not truncate width/height inputs to sixteen bits.
